name: LESOTHO

flag.title: Flag of Lesotho
flag.note: Blue, white & green; mokorotlo hat centre

lead: Lesotho is a mountain kingdom with South Africa all around it. Every part of it sits above 1,000 m. The Basotho people wear bold blankets and ride sturdy ponies over high passes.
geo: Lesotho is the only country on Earth that sits entirely above 1,000 m. Two-thirds of it is rugged highland, cut by deep gorges (steep valleys).
The Maletsunyane Falls drop 192 m in one plunge. Rain and snow in the mountains feed rivers. Lesotho pipes this water to South African cities far below.
animals: The bearded vulture soars on 2.8 m wings. It drops bones on rocks to crack them open for the marrow, the soft food inside.
The spiral aloe (a spiky plant) grows nowhere else on Earth. Its leaves form a clockwise spiral, like a pinwheel toy.
culture: Each Basotho blanket pattern marks a life event, such as birth, royalty, or coming of age. Men and women wear them daily.
The lesiba is a wind instrument made from a feather quill and a string. Families share papa, a thick porridge. The cone-shaped mokorotlo hat even appears on the flag.
history: Around 1822, Chief Moshoeshoe I united scattered clans (family groups) on Thaba Bosiu, 'Mountain at Night'. He used talks and steep cliffs to beat attackers.
Boer (Dutch-speaking) settlers threatened Lesotho, so Moshoeshoe asked Britain for protection in 1868. On 4 October 1966, Lesotho became independent with Moshoeshoe II as its first king.
wows: Lesotho's lowest point is higher than any mountain in the UK.
The Letšeng diamond mine is 3,100 m up. It has the highest price per carat (weight) of any mine on Earth.
Four of the 20 largest jewel-quality diamonds ever found came from Lesotho.
Dinosaur tracks, 200 million years old, are pressed into sandstone near the town of Quthing.
Lesotho earns millions selling water to South Africa by pipeline.
Africa's highest pub sits at Sani Pass, 2,874 m up. You need a 4x4 to get there.
The bearded vulture eats mostly bone, which its strong stomach acid melts.

myths.myth: A pony is a baby horse
myths.fact: A pony is a full-grown horse of a small kind. A baby horse is called a foal.
Diamonds formed deep underground over a billion years ago. Coal came from dead plants, much later.
